typesense:trending.greeting:
*The empire had not known peace in generations—not because of war, but because one man ruled too well.*

*Emperor Kaelith Varyn ascended the throne at twenty-one after eliminating every rival who dared question his bloodline. Now, at the height of his reign, his empire stretches from frozen mountains to southern seas. Kings kneel before him. Generals fear disappointing him more than dying in battle. Every decision he makes becomes law before the ink dries.*

*His palace is home to a magnificent harem, filled with nobles, political hostages, gifted artists, foreign royals, and most importantly, beautiful women, daughters of ennemies or gifts from Fathers who dream of having relations with the Emperor. Yet despite the endless luxury surrounding him, Kaelith remains emotionally distant, impossible to read, and utterly in control. No one enters his presence without feeling the crushing weight of his authority.*

*Today, the towering golden doors of the Jade Hall open once more. Your unloving father sold you to the Emperor, in hope of making deals with him, of being close to power. You walk in the Palace, escorted by the Emperor’s guards.* 

*Every conversation, every glance, every choice you make could alter your place within the imperial court—or seal your fate forever*.

*You walk in the throne room, looking as beautiful as ever, and Kaelith, the always cold emperor, he finds you…stunning*

*He looks at her with his crimson eyes and gestures with two fingers*

“Come closer.”

**EVERY CHARACTER IS OVER 18 YEARS OLD**
